Only return IDs that appear in <entry_catalog>. - Do NOT include entries that are clearly unrelated to the current scene. Respond ONLY with valid JSON. pool.value: Lower-cost alternative to Knowledge Retrieval. Reads a short catalog of lorebook entries (descriptions or content snippets), picks which ones are relevant to the current scene, and injects them verbatim — no per-entry summarization passes. Best for large lorebooks where you've written entry descriptions.

The system instructions this agent receives. Built-in agents have sensible defaults. You can override to customize behavior.
Select which tools this agent can use during generation. The AI can call these functions and receive results back for multi-step interactions.

What NOT to do: - Do NOT summarize, paraphrase, or quote entry content. Only return IDs. - Do NOT invent IDs. Only return IDs that appear in <entry_catalog>. - Do NOT include entries that are clearly unrelated to the current scene. Respond ONLY with valid JSON. pool: A short summary of what this agent does. Shown in the agents panel to help you identify each agent.
Who authored or maintains this agent.
Globally enables or disables this agent. Disabled agents stay configured but do not run.
When this agent runs during generation. Pre-Generation runs before the AI replies, Parallel runs alongside, Post-Processing runs after the reply is complete.
Controls how De-Koi interprets this custom agent's output. Use Text Rewrite for post-processing agents that edit the generated reply.
Optional current-turn data for custom post-processing agents. Existing agents stay isolated unless these are enabled.
Allows this custom agent to create or update entries in one selected lorebook.
Use a different AI connection for this agent. For example, use a faster/cheaper model for background processing tasks.
Controls how much recent chat context the agent reads and how much output room it reserves. If max output is too high for the model context, prompt context can be trimmed.
How many user messages should pass since this custom agent last ran before it triggers again. Set to 1 to run whenever its phase runs.
When keywords are set, this custom agent is skipped unless at least one keyword appears in the recent chat messages it scans.
When enabled, this agent's output becomes available as a marker section in prompt presets. Add the section in your preset to inject the agent's latest data into the prompt.
The system instructions this agent receives. Built-in agents have sensible defaults. You can override to customize behavior.
Select which tools this agent can use during generation. The AI can call these functions and receive results back for multi-step interactions.

calls.name: Knowledge Router
calls.description: Lower-cost alternative to Knowledge Retrieval. Reads a short catalog of lorebook entries (descriptions or content snippets), picks which ones are relevant to the current scene, and injects them verbatim — no per-entry summarization passes. Best for large lorebooks where you've written entry descriptions.
